purpose: measure ground-truth visibility, model detection, confirmatory-gate sensitivity, materiality-gate attrition, bounded discovery sensitivity and full-pipeline specificity for small noisy sparse clustered conditional edge before B2-06 scientific execution

diagnostic_meaning.GROUND_TRUTH_VISIBLE: truth-aware diagnostic only; injected support-conditional mean shift has frozen block-bootstrap q025 > 0; unavailable to evaluator selection
diagnostic_meaning.STRICT_PASS: STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY AND unchanged pooled relative-MAE >= 0.02 gate

sample_sizes.era_partition: five equal contiguous row ranges; N is divisible by 5 for all frozen N

dgp.independence: U1, U2, mechanism transition uniforms and RAW innovations mutually independent within a world; streams namespaced

baseline.realism_limitation: V1 does not calibrate candidate absorption of baseline-model misspecification

effect_scale_reference.ceiling_interpretation: unchanged 2 percent pooled materiality is expected unreachable for stationary positive ladder; this is diagnostic, not a reason to alter DGP
effect_scale_reference.scale_matched_materiality_metric: observed_RELATIVE_MAE_IMPROVEMENT/asymptotic_max_relative_mae_improvement_approx; unavailable for nonpositive denominator; descriptive only and not a detection/promotion gate

monte_carlo.failed_world_policy: failed or invalid worlds remain planned denominator; aggregate becomes INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION and emits no methodology PASS/FAIL claim
monte_carlo.indeterminate_escalation: no automatic second batch; increasing worlds after outcome inspection requires a new prereg/version and fresh world identities

rng_authority.world_seed: SHA256 UTF8(root_seed_decimal+'|'+identity), first 8 raw bytes big-endian unsigned
rng_authority.namespace_seed: SHA256 UTF8(world_seed_int_decimal+'|'+namespace+optional ordered context), first 8 raw bytes big-endian unsigned

forecast.invalid_fit_policy: missing required rank or any non-finite coefficient/prediction/statistic => affected world invalid; stays planned denominator; INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION; no replacement or reroll

metrics.SUPPORT_RUN_LENGTHS: contiguous positive runs; era boundary breaks run
metrics.EFFECTIVE_SUPPORT_N: N_positive/(1+2*sum rho_k); rho pairs included only while adjacent pair sum remains positive; first nonpositive pair and later lags excluded; if none then all estimable positive-pair lags; cap [1,N_positive]; reporting only
metrics.support_sanity_interpretation: separate attrition gate, not model-power metric; sparse clustered worlds below candidate-positive count 50 must be reported separately

ground_truth_visibility.block_construction: era-local consecutive nonoverlap blocks from era start; retain short final block; sample original block count with replacement per era; concatenate sampled blocks and truncate to original era row count; concatenate E2..E5
ground_truth_visibility.invalid: any nominal replicate missing either S class => world visibility false + visibility_invalid=true; no replacement/reroll
ground_truth_visibility.truth_access: artifact diagnostic only; forbidden to fitting/selection/placebo/ties

strict_reference_gate.era_stability: positive mean improvement in >=3 of 4 scored eras
strict_reference_gate.support_sanity: candidate-positive scored count>=50 finite/nonzero; ORACLE equals true support; BLIND candidate-specific

bootstrap.block_construction: same era-local sampling/truncation as visibility, applied to AE_IMPROVEMENT rows
bootstrap.invalid_replicate_policy: any nominal non-finite/invalid replicate => candidate/world cannot satisfy bootstrap_positive; world invalid; stays denominator; INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION; no replacement or reroll

placebo.operation: permute literal evaluated Fj within each original era per replicate; use same replicate-specific permuted historical table across expanding fits; Y/X1/X2/order fixed
placebo.invalid_replicate_policy: any nominal non-finite/invalid replicate => candidate/world cannot satisfy placebo_separation; world invalid; stays denominator; INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION; no replacement or reroll
placebo.calibration_scope: within-era permutation is empirically calibrated by frozen NULL full-pipeline arm; no claim of exact arbitrary clustered-feature permutation null

discovery.selection: among STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY choose max MEAN_AE_IMPROVEMENT; tie ascending ID; none NO_CANDIDATE
discovery.true_vs_proxy_interpretation: descriptive mechanism-recovery detail only; report Wilson; weak-rung split may be noise-dominated; no methodology consequence from TRUE-vs-PROXY split alone

discovery.bound: Wilson lower for PASS; Wilson upper below min for FAIL; otherwise INDETERMINATE
discovery.TRUE_DISCOVERY_reporting: always report Wilson interval; descriptive HIGH/MODERATE/LOW/VERY_LOW band only when whole interval fits; otherwise INDETERMINATE_TRUE_RECOVERY

acceptance.discovery_diagnosis_priority: specificity failure first; then ORACLE confirmatory power failure; then BLIND useful-discovery failure => DISCOVERY_BOTTLENECK; any required boundary-straddling Wilson => CALIBRATION_INDETERMINATE; else NO_V1_EVIDENCE_OF_DISCOVERY_BOTTLENECK
acceptance.detection_floor: VISIBILITY_FLOOR if visibility Wilson upper<0.50; else MODEL_FLOOR if model Wilson upper<0.50; else ABOVE_MEASURED_FLOOR
acceptance.materiality: compare strict-ex-materiality vs strict plus fraction-of-attainable

conclusion_authority.discovery_bottleneck: controlled specificity + adequate ORACLE confirmatory power + EASY or MODERATE BLIND USEFUL_DISCOVERY FAIL => DISCOVERY_BOTTLENECK_BEFORE_B2_06
conclusion_authority.visibility_floor: comparable negative market result cannot strongly establish absence
conclusion_authority.model_floor: repair model/evaluation or carry explicit power caveat
conclusion_authority.materiality_only: record gate suppression; no authorization to change market gate
conclusion_authority.no_discovery_bottleneck: controlled specificity + adequate ORACLE sanity power + adequate BLIND useful discovery => NO_V1_EVIDENCE_OF_DISCOVERY_BOTTLENECK

execution_ceremony: persist complete result before methodology changes
